rowText: Start a brand-new, empty chat while the panel is showing a Session context row from another chat, then walk Down/Right/Left/Down/Up from the question box; a hit is Down/Right/Left/Down all failing to move and only Up escaping.

setup.prior_chat: a chat with turns, Session context showing

steps.action: Moved to the [+] new-chat slot and pressed A.
steps.observed: The ghost-reply bug showed again briefly (already proven, not re-tested on purpose) -- closed and reopened the panel to clear it, per its own known fix.

steps.action: From the now-genuinely-empty new chat (Session context (1 turn) showing), walked Down three times toward the question area.
steps.observed: Every Down press moved the highlighted control along normally -- no trap this try.

verdictSentence: This try did not reproduce the focus trap in Hades either -- Down kept moving normally through a brand-new chat.
notes: The separate Ask-bar problem (Down/Right stuck after a chip fills the box) was confirmed again in this same Hades session -- see plan61-ASKBAR-FOCUS-TRAP-01.json. That is a different control (the Ask box, after a chip is chosen) than this recipe's question-box-in-a-new-chat test, so both are recorded separately.
